stories.title: VA won't require existing FedRAMP certification for cloud contracts, memo reveals
stories.why: VA will award cloud contracts without requiring existing FedRAMP certification, removing a gate that has slowed younger cloud vendors in VA procurements, while the memo holds vendors to security standards.

stories.title: Navy using LETHALITY Consortium to advance network consolidation initiative
stories.why: The Navy is executing IT and data-architecture modernization at NSWC Corona through the LETHALITY Consortium, underscoring consortium membership as a practical route into naval modernization work.

stories.title: Homeland Security plans to add more AI to FOIA processing
stories.why: The agency wants automation tools to improve efficiency amid an increasing volume of requests.

stories.title: DFARS: Modifications to Printed Circuit Board Acquisition Restrictions (DFARS Case 2022-D011)
stories.why: DoD's proposed DFARS revision on printed circuit board acquisition restrictions implements NDAA supply-chain mandates; hardware vendors selling into defense should assess sourcing exposure and consider commenting.

stories.title: DoD is looking for new ways to bring commercial innovation into national security
stories.why: DoD is reexamining which commercial business models it will accept in national-security acquisition, a signal for non-traditional vendors to watch for new entry paths beyond conventional contracts.
